name: Hero Strike
description:
About This Game

All the RTS strategy. Zero micro.

Hero Strike is a 3v3 online tug-of-war strategy battler built around pure tactical decision-making. There are no workers to babysit and no frantic control groups to juggle. When your wave spawns, your army marches and fights automatically. Victory belongs to the team that drafts smarter, positions better, and adapts faster between waves.

Every unit you place in your deployment zone becomes a permanent part of your war machine, spawning fresh on every single wave until an enemy Citadel falls.

Draft your warband, then pick your Hero

No two matches play the same. Before battle begins, draft a custom 12-unit roster across three tiers from a pool of 75+ fantasy units, spanning frontline tanks, ranged carries, support casters, flyers, and heavy siege. Use your two Shuffles to keep your core picks while rerolling the rest for the missing piece of your composition, then lock in one of 12 distinct Heroes built to supercharge the army you just drafted.

Your deployment grid is a blueprint

Where you place a unit matters just as much as what you buy. Your grid spacing dictates the exact second each troop hits the front line:

  • Anchor your front row with heavy armor and stagger melee bruisers on the flanks to wrap around enemy lines.

  • Space your ranged DPS, support casters, and siege units in the backline so their spells and volleys land the instant the armies collide.

  • Watch how the wave plays out, spot the weakness in your opponent's setup, and re-engineer your formation before the next spawn.

Win your wave. Snowball the map.

Three players share a single massive lane, spawning in rotating head-to-head waves. Every clash is both a personal duel against your direct counterpart and part of a relentless 3v3 tug-of-war. Crush your rival's wave, and your surviving troops don't disappear. They march forward to join your teammate's incoming wave, turning a clean counter-build into a multi-army push that breaks enemy fortifications.

Greed for income or seize the Middle Line

Every gold coin is a test of nerve. Do you spend now to dominate the next wave, or invest in passive income upgrades and tech to Tier 2 and Tier 3 while trusting your teammates to hold the line? Push the battle past the center of the map to capture the Middle Line, earning bonus gold every second for your side while starving your opponent of theirs.

Evolve your Heroes & counters mid-match

As enemies fall, your Hero levels up on the battlefield, earning skill points to rank up abilities and talent points to progress down 10-tier branching talent trees. Swap multi-form Heroes between combat stances between waves, unlock unit-specific upgrades that transform your drafted troops, and spend your late-game war chest to recruit a second or third Hero onto the field to break a stalemate.

Key features

  • 3v3 Tug-of-War Battles: Rotating player waves collide down a single contested lane where every surviving unit adds momentum to the next push.

  • Pre-Match Army Draft: Build a custom 12-unit deck every match from 75+ units across three tiers, complete with selective Shuffles to pivot your strategy.

  • 12 Playable Heroes: Command distinct Heroes with powerful ultimates, 10-tier branching talent trees, stance-swapping combat forms, and late-game multi-hero recruitment.

  • Deep Counter-Play, Zero APM Stress: Automatic combat paired with smart tactical levers. Customize unit upgrades, tweak formation timing, and toggle per-unit Spell AI rules when you want fine control.

  • High-Stakes Economy: Balance immediate army strength against income scaling, tier tech, and control of the contested Middle Line.

  • Play With Anyone, Anywhere: Dedicated global servers with built-in, real-time chat translation across 14 languages.

Hero Strike is an online multiplayer game. An internet connection is required to play.
short_desc: All the strategy of a classic RTS with zero micro required. Draft your army from 75+ fantasy units, command a leveling Hero, and engineer formations that spawn fresh every wave. Counter your rival, seize the middle line for bonus gold, and crush the enemy Citadel in 3v3 tug-of-war battles.
